edges: Lady Pelham helps Laura receive her annuity

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Laura accepts Colonel Hargrave on grounds of moral incompatibility
Hargrave threatens to kill himself, causing Laura to faint.
The families in the village consider the children to be well-behaved and disciplined.
The Duke grows closer to all three of his children and allows their engagements.
Laura is found by her father after fainting.
